title: City of Sunderland Coleus - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Vibrant Foliage Plant
description:
Bring a burst of tropical colour to your home or garden with 'City of Sunderland' Coleus!
KEY FEATURES
• Striking burgundy-red and lime-green variegated foliage
• Ideal for beds, patio containers, and indoor displays
• Easy to grow and quick to fill out
• Provides vibrant, long-lasting colour throughout summer
• Can be overwintered indoors as a tender perennial
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Coleus scutellarioides 'City of Sunderland'
Colour: Red and Green foliage
Season: Foliage interest year-round (indoors), Summer (outdoors)
Growth Habit: Shrubby, bushy plant
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Bright, indirect light; tolerates moderate sunshine
Soil: Fertile, free-draining peat-free houseplant compost
Watering: Keep compost evenly moist, allowing top 2-3cm to dry slightly between waterings
Spacing: 30-45 cm (12-18 inches)
Height: 30-60 cm (12-24 inches)
Spread: 30-60 cm (12-24 inches)
Hardiness: Tender perennial (USDA Zone 10+ outdoors, otherwise grown as annual or overwintered indoors)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Pinch out growing tips regularly to encourage dense, bushy growth.
• Remove any small flower spikes to direct energy into foliage production.
• Protect from temperatures below 10°C; bring indoors before first frost.
• Feed every 2-4 weeks during spring and summer with a balanced liquid fertiliser.
• Ensure good drainage to prevent root rot, especially in containers.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
1x Mini Plug Plant
